opportunities.name: Court case lookup with statute and note
opportunities.description: Search a Supreme Court case on CourtListener, open it, look up the related statute on Cornell LII, then save a summary note.
steps: Open CourtListener and click the keyword search box
Type the case name and press Enter
Search the related statute on Cornell LII
Add a note with case citation, decision date and statute
